About this item

  • BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE — Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself and get things done effortlessly. With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no one else can access your data — not even Apple.
  • TAKE TOTAL CAMERA CONTROL — Camera Control gives you an easier way to quickly access camera tools, like zoom or depth of field, so you can take the perfect shot in record time.
  • GET FURTHER AND CLOSER — The improved Ultra Wide camera with autofocus lets you take incredibly detailed macro photos and videos. Use the 48MP Fusion camera for stunning high-resolution images, and zoom in with the 2x optical-quality Telephoto.
  • PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLES — The latest-generation Photographic Styles give you greater creative flexibility, so you can make every photo even more you. And you can reverse any of those styles anytime you want.
  • SUPER-SMART A18 CHIP — A18 jumps two generations ahead of the A16 Bionic chip in iPhone 15. It enables Apple Intelligence, powers advanced photo and video features, and supports console-level gaming, with exceptional power efficiency.

    How are ratings calculated?
    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    Customers say

    Customers find the iPhone's quality excellent and consider it worth the price, with positive feedback about its appearance and speed, particularly noting that apps open quickly. However, the performance receives mixed reviews, with some reporting issues with the front camera and calling sensor. The battery life and display quality also get mixed reactions - while some praise the battery boost, others report it doesn't last more than 4 hours, and while the picture quality is nice, one customer points out the outdated 60 Hz display.

      5 out of 5 stars
      All rounder hero phone
      Reviewed in India on 15 April 2026
      Colour: UltramarineSize: 128 GBConfiguration: Without Apple Care
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Something new cannot be written in a review for a device that has been reviewed thousands of times over the Internet. I'll put in the perspective of how a device for an its festive price of ~70k has exceeded expectations from all counts. Being an all rounder & being a hero phone seems easy these days (plethora of choices & awards showcases it). But being both, with supreme ability, in its budget segment is nothing short of an accomplishment. Summarising it in pros & cons for easy reference:

      Pros

      + iOS is the main STAR! Fluidic, snappy and so easy to use that it feels natural

      + There are better cameras but there aren't good point-shoot-auto correct cameras that handle all the work for you & produce spectacular photos/videos with 0 adjustments at this price

      + Build Quality & Brand Recognition is off the charts

      + Battery Backup is superb with easy 7-8 hours with no gaming & 3-4 hours of social media usage

      + It'll last easy for 5-6 years with Apple's long term software support & resale value is very strong

      Cons

      - A very good quality case (Spigen/Raeger) is highly recommended to protect investment. Repairs/Damages are costly

      - Display should & could have been better. Well something had to be kept for the 17

      - Gets really warm when on wireless charging

      - 20W wired charging. LoL!

      - Dedicated camera control is useless. It needs to be programmable

    • Amit Kohli
      4 out of 5 stars
      Powerful performance and battery boost - worth the upgrade
      Reviewed in India on 11 March 2026
      Colour: BlackSize: 128 GBConfiguration: Without Apple Care
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I’ve been using the iPhone 16 (128 GB) for a few months now and it’s been a very good experience overall. The new A18 chip makes everything feel faster - apps open instantly, multitasking is smooth, and without lag. The camera control feature is a standout, giving more flexibility for photos and videos and the results are sharp with excellent color balance. Battery life is noticeably better than previous models; I can get through a full day of heavy use without worrying about charging. The 5G connectivity is reliable and makes streaming and downloads quick.

      Pros:

      - A18 chip delivers fast, smooth performance

      - Camera control adds flexibility and professional feel

      - Big battery boost; lasts comfortably through the day

      - 5G support; strong and stable connectivity

      - Premium build quality; sleek design

      Cons:

      - Pricey compared to other 5G phones

      - 128 GB storage may feel limited for heavy video users

      - No major design changes from earlier models

      Bottom line: A very good upgrade - powerful, reliable, and with real improvements in battery and camera. If you value performance and everyday dependability, the iPhone 16 is a strong choice.
